headline: JP Morgan Maintains Neutral on Principal Financial Group, Raises Price Target to $107
summary: JP Morgan  analyst Pablo Singzon   maintains Principal Financial Group (NASDAQ:PFG) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $106 to $107.
